node.title: Re: Is foreach split Optimized?
node.author: ikegami
node.doctext:
I also found several references to @x = split ... being optimized

That's just a normal call to `split`. It's actually the following that's optimized: ($x, $y, $z) = split ...;

It only finds and returns the first three items instead of all of them. Obviously, that optimization can't be used for @a = split ...;

[id://594208|This post] lists the for optimizations.
